introduction: Video excerpt from the Cold War video

vocabulary.definition: to make something official or valid
vocabulary.example: The United States formalizes the agreement at the Yalta Conference.

vocabulary.definition: a promise or pledge to do something
vocabulary.example: The USSR makes a commitment to attack Japan within three months.

vocabulary.definition: to create something again or in a new form
vocabulary.example: The three nations agreed to recreate Poland after the war.

vocabulary.definition: areas of land under the jurisdiction of a ruler or state
vocabulary.example: The USSR will keep the territories it has conquered.

vocabulary.definition: to divide or separate a country or territory into parts
vocabulary.example: Germany and Austria will be occupied and partitioned after the war.

vocabulary.definition: the state of being harmed or damaged
vocabulary.example: Moving Poland further west was to Germany's detriment.
